red_tests.failure_fingerprint: 157 failed, 23 passed; one stable missing-entrypoint AssertionError plus 156 lazy-import ModuleNotFoundError failures for scripts.multiagent_idq_mvp_080_operational; all 23 general side-effect and normal/linked Git mutation negative controls passed

correction_reason: Independent sequence-3 review found five residual gaps in the sequence-2 superseding baseline: (1) failed all-four preflights, non-UNUSED AUTH-02 states, and replay did not share one byte-for-byte zero-side-effect oracle covering the SQLite queue database and any WAL/SHM files, capacity and nonce-marker stores, all fixture input/config/authorization files, captured stdout/stderr, and normal or linked Git worktree, gitdir, common-dir refs, HEAD, index, and status authority; (2) request_id, root, provider, and the actual job, request, QOBS, and capacity-lease lane identities were not parameterized across all four aliases; (3) provider-native malformed-output coverage omitted schema-invalid mapping WorkResults and two distinct competing terminal WorkResults for both Codex and AGY; (4) no single exact oracle asserted every required receipt key and value for every DONE and UNKNOWN result, especially timeout and repository drift; and (5) fake execution mutated only a tracked worktree file and did not separately exercise index-only, per-worktree-ref-only, HEAD-only, and common-ref drift under both normal and linked-worktree semantics. This test-only correction closes those gaps without changing the acceptance scope or source allowlist.
rationale: Freeze the third independently reviewed IDQ-MVP-080 operational-provider contract before the sole owned source exists. The fake-Popen-only suite preserves the stable missing-entrypoint RED sentinel and lazy imports while adding exact state snapshots and targeted negative controls, all-field AUTH-02 and actual-lane binding barriers for codex1, codex2, agy1, and agy2, native schema-invalid and competing-terminal WorkResult rejection, one complete receipt oracle for every successful and ambiguous lane, and one-shot bounded cleanup after tracked-file, index-only, per-worktree-ref-only, HEAD-only, and common-ref drift in normal and linked Git fixtures. It performs no provider, network, credential, source, documentation, deployment, or release action; the only eligible later source remains scripts/multiagent_idq_mvp_080_operational.py.
